content.name: Indomitable
entries: Beginning at 9th level, you can reroll a saving throw that you fail. If you do so, you must use the new roll, and you can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.
You can use this feature twice between long rests starting at 13th level and three times between long rests starting at 17th level.

content.name: Indomitable
entries: If you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Fighter level. You must use the new roll, and you can't use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.
You can use this feature twice before a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52} starting at level 13 and three times before a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52} starting at level 17.
